summary: Iteration 12 (OTP-disabled auth, admin pricing rules, manual driver verification, Messages tab, India place search). Backend: new suite test_iter12 23/25 pass; iter9 featured/reviews regression 14/14 pass after updating its obsolete setup. Frontend (375x667): auth OTP default mode + disabled notice + email toggle/login, tabs Home/Offer/Bookings/Messages with badge, messages list -> chat send/receive, /profile verify-phone card (link-* disabled), Offer recommended price (auto-follow, edit keeps, use-recommended resets, over-cap), trip-price-suggestion w/o fuel/toll, /driver single upload button, manual verification form (4 docs, inline errors, upload preview), /driver/ai-verification renders same form, admin driver review fields + approve, admin pricing editor save/restore, admin users search by phone, Hire a Driver animated SVG -> /hire, booking end-to-end all WORK. Failures: PUT /api/me has no phone validation; Kohima search duplicate; rounding mismatch between UI and API price cap. No deprecated Expo packages detected. No SafeAreaView issues detected.

critical.issue: No phone validation: {phone:'12345'} returns 200 and is saved (spec: 10-digit validation). Also API lets phone-verified users overwrite `phone` (desyncs from phone_e164; UI hides field but API is open). Reference: server.py:736-752 (ProfileIn/update_me)

minor.issue: Python round() is banker's rounding, frontend uses Math.round. 143 km sedan 2 seats: API recommended 500/max 750, Offer UI shows 501/max 752, so UI accepts 751-752 that backend rejects with 400. Use math.floor(x+0.5) in server.py:1213-1215 (or have UI call /api/pricing/suggest).

Duplicate city: local 'in_kohima_nagaland' (Kohima, Kohima, Nagaland) + OSM 'osm_n3613137018' (Kohima, '', Nagaland, ~1.5 km apart, both type city). Dedupe should merge same name+state+type within a few km even when district is blank. Other queries (Kempegowda bus station, Port Blair, Leh, 560001, Mumbai CSMT) OK.
System messages (sys_message booking created/confirmed, sender_id 'system') count as unread: passenger badge showed 3 for 1 real message. Consider excluding sender_id 'system' from unread.
Return leg gets no price_suggestion; still copies trip['cost_breakdown'] (dead). cost_breakdown(), MILEAGE_DEFAULTS and /api/fuel-prices are dead code now. server.py:1117,1223-1234,1317-1318
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not present in backend/.env -> 'object storage init failed' at startup; uploads silently fall back to storing binary in MongoDB files.data. Works, but not intended storage.

ui_bugs.issue: Badge stays at 3 after opening and reading the chat and returning (only 15s polling in (tabs)/_layout.tsx:20). Refresh on tab focus / after chat read.
Disabled notice reuses auth copy 'Existing users can sign in with email below.' - wrong in Profile context.
Says 'Verify it in Profile' but OTP is off; user must use Edit profile (backend says 'Profile -> Edit profile').

integration_issues.issue: UI max (Math.round) can exceed backend max by 1-2 rupees -> publish 400 at boundary.
